My mother's name was Merope. Merope Gaunt. She died shortly after I was born — a fact I learned only later, when I bothered to look into the matter. She was a witch, though you would never have guessed it from the state she was in by the end. She let herself waste away for the sake of a man who never deserved her. I have little patience for that kind of weakness, even if it is my own blood.
